name: Romergoline
summary: Romergoline is a dopamine receptor modulator of the ergoline family which was under development for the treatment of Parkinson's disease and psychotic disorders but was never marketed. It is closely related to the psychedelic drug LSD in terms of chemical structure, though it is not technically a lysergamide itself as the oxygen atom of LSD's carboxamide moiety has been removed to instead form an aminomethyl moiety.
